_comment: naive_ext_64kcap_v2.json with TMax 4B's loss: DPPO (binary-TV trust region against the sampler, threshold 0.1, ratio cap 10; allenai/tmax-4b) instead of PPO clipping. Everything else is v2's (no KL, centered advantages without std normalization, 64k end-at-limit, TITO, toolcap 64, remote sandboxes 640, recovery every 5, stall guard). The loss is harnessforge.train.losses.dppo, registered in the trainer with miles-tinker's custom-loss hook (--tinker-custom-loss dppo=..., gateway.custom_losses; miles-tinker deployed to ~/hf-dev/train/miles-tinker-dppo). Client: platoon-dppo-venv (platoon-tito2 venv + patches/platoon-dppo.patch: tinker LossFnType admits dppo, zero-advantage filter as under ppo, optim/dppo_* metrics). New run dir; nothing of the v2 run is reused.

labels.loss: DPPO (TMax 4B): binary TV divergence, threshold 0.1, ratio cap 10, trust region anchored at the sampler's logprobs; no PPO clipping
